title: Schedule Actor-Learner Updates
summary: The learner should not consume an unbounded update budget merely because it runs faster than robot collection.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Normalized observation/action coordinates and reward probabilities are dimensionless. Interaction/reset durations use seconds. Counters and indices are exact integers.

physical_contract.axes: Record, trial, controller-channel and source dimensions are declared in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Transitions follow the caller-declared fixed control period within each recorded episode; no implicit clock or coordinate conversion. Scheduler ticks are accounting events, not a promised wall-clock cadence.
physical_contract.batching: Record, trial, controller-channel and source dimensions are declared in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded operational component motivated by SERL/HIL-SERL. It does not reproduce the entire learner, authorize physical robot execution or establish deployment safety.
